# Wizuale

> Wizuale is two separate apps. On Apple TV, classic Milkdrop presets, the kind Winamp used, fill the screen when you play a record or music on the television. The TV looks up the song and takes its BPM from GetSongBPM, so the picture has a tempo even without a microphone. Wizuale Mic is a second app, for iPhone, on the same Wi-Fi. After it connects, the phone shows the Apple TV and the picture bounces to the beat in the room. You can pick a preset on the phone, or let them advance on their own.

Wizuale is an independent app built by Dawid Woźniak and Sature. The microphone audio stays on the local Wi-Fi between the iPhone and the Apple TV. There is no account.

## What it does

- Full screen classic Milkdrop presets on Apple TV, the kind Winamp used
- BPM from GetSongBPM, from the song title and artist, even with no microphone
- Wizuale Mic, a separate iPhone app, sends the sound in the room over the same Wi-Fi so the picture bounces to the beat
- The phone shows which Apple TV it is connected to
- Pick a preset, or leave auto-advance on

## Product

- [Wizuale](https://wizuale.dawidw.pl/): visuals for Apple TV, plus Wizuale Mic for iPhone
- [Privacy](https://wizuale.dawidw.pl/privacy.html): the microphone stream stays on your Wi-Fi, and there is no account
- [Terms](https://wizuale.dawidw.pl/terms.html): terms of use
